# TokenVector.Data Architecture Summary (v1.0.9 / library v2.2)

`TokenVector.Data` is a columnar DataFrame and tabular data library **natively
implemented in the TokenVector language** (`tvsrc/*.tkv`, 18 modules) and
compiled to a .NET CIL DLL (`TokenVector.Data.dll`, class `TKVApp`) via
`tkvc` + `ilasm`. No C# sources remain.

## Storage
- 4 dtypes (`i64`, `f64`, `bool`, `str`) + narrow tags (`series_astype`:
  i8..u64, f32, datetime64); datetime = i64 epoch-ms UTC.
- Nulls: per-column Arrow-style mask (`Mask`), not NaN-sentinels.
- `Series`/`DataFrame` are records; all ops are free functions
  (`series_*`, `vec_*`, `groupby_*`, `df_*`, `win_*`, `dt_*`), no method
  chaining, no labeled index (position-based).

## Modules
- data / compute (vec math, filter, aggs, window incl. ewm) / relational
  (groupby, 4-way joins + AsOf + merge-on-index, pivot/melt/stack) / sort /
  stats (corr/cov/skew/kurt) / datetime / strings (~34 ops + .NET regex) /
  apply (func/lambda callbacks) / dtype / pandas-closure (`df_eval`,
  `df_query`, factorize) / read_json / p100 (index/rolling/resample extras).
- `tokenvector_sql.tkv`: SELECT engine (`sql_query`/`sql_query2`) -
  WHERE/GROUP BY/HAVING/ORDER BY/LIMIT/DISTINCT, JOINs, IN/LIKE, 10 aggs.
- `tokenvector_excel.tkv`: SpreadsheetML 2003 read/write (Excel opens it).
- `tokenvector_parquet.tkv`: honest stubs (real Parquet needs compiler
  binary write + bitwise ops).
- `tokenvector_io.tkv`: CSV (quotes, inference, chunks, encodings,
  parallel `csv_read_par`), JSON/NDJSON; `tokenvector_arrow.tkv`: ARROW1
  internal stream + out-of-core batches; `tokenvector_numerics.tkv`: Mat
  bridge (zero-copy f64).

## Verification
- 21 native suites (`tvsrc/*_check.tkv`), all green on stock `tkvc`
  (sql 43/43, excel 33/33, p2 154/154, p100 74/74); DLL smoke 54/54 symbols.
- Docs: README, FUNCTION_PARITY (pandas/Polars), BENCHMARKS (same-machine),
  SESSION_HANDOFF (build log).
